finalResult.currentParagraphText: “So the Holy Church has quite the presence in surrounding galaxies?” Jake asked, wondering if they’d even gotten a strong foothold in the Andro-
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “The Andromeda Galaxy has, for all intents and purposes, been wholly taken over by the Holy Church. Even before the Prima Guardian event, it was mostly conquered using the Prima Alliance system, and after the system event, I believe the takeover will be complete,” Jacob explained. “Some other factions do also retain a presence there, but the one officially ruling everything will be the Holy Church, of that there is no doubt.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Of course,” Jacob nodded. “And quite nearby, too. This is another reason why we wanted this matter settled without there publicly being a lot of bad blood between the Holy Church and the faction you are creating. Sure, the relationship won’t be good, we with the agreement today, there will at least be a precedent that we can be diplomatic, which is pretty needed as even if you push the Holy Church out of this galaxy, we’re still neighbors.”
